items.quote: Den unterschriebenen Vertrag benötigen wir innerhalb von 14 Werktagen ab dem Briefdatum zurück.
items.computation: Letter dated Wed 2026-11-18 (Briefdatum = start of period, anchor). Period is 14 Werktage, defined by the letter itself as Monday–Saturday, excluding Sundays and public holidays. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the triggering event (18.11.) is not counted, so counting starts 2026-11-19. Counting 14 such working days from 2026-11-18 (confirmed by rules engine and working-day calculator, skipping Sundays 2026-11-22 and 2026-11-29, no public holidays in that span in NW) lands on Friday 2026-12-04.
